body:
## Problem

Current Studio b721 can classify unconfirmed speech-recognition observations as a child's reading weakness. Its Memory adapter can also acknowledge failed persistence from SharedPreferences' optimistic cache.

## Changes

This draft adds exactly four files relative to b721: two narrow product corrections and two new regression files. The 4,365 other existing file leaves remain byte-identical.

- Memory reloads the actual preferences platform before every round/statistics read. This also covers newly constructed adapters over the same singleton after failed writes/reloads. Existing owner checks, serial controller, reward identity, rules, keys and committed-write recovery remain unchanged.
- Parent reports and daily recommendations use existing SkillRecords instead of unconfirmed ASR summaries for competence judgments. Raw summaries and historical saved data remain untouched. Genuine positive/negative assessed learning evidence remains available.
- Fourteen new Memory durability/profile cases use the real SharedPreferences cache against controlled platform responses.
- Ten new ASR boundary cases cover poor/perfect recognition, another profile, genuine skill records and unchanged legacy summary data.

## Review and validation

Head `28462a7547048b75fa114e6f5832248e54c94faa`, tree `21cc39c37c96c8d76d46434b42b172e88ffb745e`, parent `b7210db3f53361987fd33592de438fd7984d991a`.

The two implementation agents, independent peer reviewer and integration owner reviewed exact source bytes; all four Git blobs were read back and verified. The complete tree comparison confirmed exactly two modifications, two additions and no deletions. Native pin 29080, APK version, workflows and original assets remain unchanged.

Actual CI is now required. The 24 cases were prepared, not executed locally; no passing test result is inferred from source review. The existing complete Flutter, host compilation, speech and persistence gates are retained.

## Integration

Targets `chatgpt/lumo-studio-2020-20261114`, not Main. After successful current gates the development Studio branch can advance and rerun all APK, Android API35/API37, Creative and update-preservation gates. No production Main merge is requested. Historical b721 evidence remains intact in PR477.
